陈近岳指着王野半天说不出话来，秦伟赶紧抓住陈近岳指着王野的手说：“来来，老陈咱去书房说，在院子里算怎么回事儿啊？”

陈近岳甩开秦伟的手，直接向书房走去。秦伟看向王野，眼神询问怎么回事儿，王野轻轻摇了摇头也不说话。

舅甥两人跟着陈近岳也走向书房，陈近岳对于秦家那是相当熟悉，直接推门进入书房一屁股就坐在了沙发上，把手里的枪狠狠的拍在茶几上。

秦伟带着王野进门，王野在后面把门带上，就站在门边。秦伟则坐到陈近岳的旁边。陈近岳一看这小子站的位置一拍桌子怒吼道：“你个小兔崽子站那么远干什么？”

王野平静的说：“陈大爷，你的枪还在手边呢，这要是你拿枪我好跑。”

秦伟说：“老陈，多大的事儿还值得动枪。”

陈近岳没好气的说：“你这大外甥欺负了我家兮兮。”

秦伟一听这话猛的站了起来，指着王野半天说不出话来。深出了口气转头对着陈近岳说：“老陈，这事儿算我对不起你，小野还小有气你冲我撒，放心我一定让小野负责。”

王野都愣住了，自己干什么了就负责。最多就是当初划船时碰了一下小手，这就要负责，太过分了吧。陈近岳赶紧说：“负责，负什么责，秦二愣子你踏马想什么好事儿呢，不是那个欺负。”

秦伟长出了口气说：“哦哦，不是那个呀，吓死我了。”

陈近岳白了他一眼也不说话。秦伟继续说：“老陈，那你倒是说说怎么回事儿呀？”

陈近岳说：“老秦，你是不知道啊，今天兮兮不是跟着天韵去她姑姑家了吗，这臭小子对我家兮兮爱搭不理的。你说说我家兮兮什么时候被人这么冷落过？”

秦伟好奇的等着陈近岳继续说，可是到这里陈近岳没下文了，秦伟等了一会儿就问“然后呢？”

陈近岳说：“什么然后呢，没了啊。”

这下轮到秦伟发飙了，一拍桌子喊道：“陈疯子，你踏马就因为这事儿拿着枪到我家来？你是不是觉得老子比你小两岁就好欺负呀？”

陈近岳见秦伟发飙了，也觉得拿着枪理亏就磕磕绊绊的说：“那个，那个不是气急了吗，对气急了。”

转头看了一眼王野没好气的说：“先不说这个，先说这小子。”

王野见又回到了自己身上很无辜的看着两人也不说话。陈近岳说：“臭小子说说吧，为什么不搭理我家兮兮，她就这么让你讨厌？”

王野上前两步走到茶几边说：“陈大爷，洛兮姑娘长得漂亮，性格又好我怎么会讨厌呢，只是我们不是一个世界的人。”

陈近岳说：“什么叫不是一个世界的人，你原来没认你舅舅之前还说的过去。现在还这样说是不是不合适了？”

王野看着两人也不说话。秦伟看不下去了就说：“小野，有什么就说，我也想知道。”

王野想了一下说：“舅舅，陈大爷今天既然话说到这儿了，我就说点我的想法。我呢从小在农村长大，后来进了城接触的也是家长里短，对于上面的问题没接触过，也不想接触太累。”

“我就想着好好上班，没事儿给家里改善一下伙食，将来找个媳妇。好好给我爷爷奶奶太爷爷他们养个老。我不想进仕途，也不想从军。就想过个踏踏实实的日子。”

陈近岳说：“你想过踏实日子和不理我家兮兮有关系吗？”

王野说：“陈大爷，您是大将军下面孩子之间的问题在您眼里就是闹着玩儿，可是我不一样啊，就洛兮姑娘周围的苍蝇就能烦死我，我也不能一个个的都打残了吧。”

Chen Jinyue pointed at Wang Ye and was speechless for a long time. Qin Wei quickly grabbed Chen Jinyue's hand pointing at Wang Ye and said, "Come on, old Chen, let's go to the study and ask, what's going on in the yard?"

Chen Jinyue shook off Qin Wei's hand and walked directly to the study.Qin Wei looked at Wang Ye and asked what was going on. Wang Ye shook his head lightly and said nothing.

The uncle and nephew followed Chen Jinyue to the study. Chen Jinyue was very familiar with the Qin family. He directly pushed the door into the study and sat down on the sofa, slamming the gun in his hand on the coffee table.

Qin Wei took Wang Ye through the door. Wang Ye closed the door behind him and stood by the door.Qin Wei sat next to Chen Jinyue.When Chen Jinyue saw where the boy was standing, he slapped the table and roared: "Why are you standing so far away, you little brat?"

Wang Ye said calmly: "Uncle Chen, you still have your gun at hand. If you take the gun, I can run away."

Qin Wei said: "Old Chen, how big of a problem is it worth using a gun to do?"

Chen Jinyue said angrily: "Your nephew bullied my family Xixi."

When Qin Wei heard this, he stood up suddenly and pointed at Wang Ye, speechless for a long time.He took a deep breath and turned to Chen Jinyue and said, "Old Chen, I'm sorry for this. If Xiaoye is still angry, you can blame me. Don't worry, I will let Xiaoye take responsibility."

Wang Ye was stunned. He was responsible for whatever he did.At most, I touched my little hand while rowing, so I have to take responsibility for it, which is too much.Chen Jinyue said quickly: "Responsibility, what responsibility do you have? Qin Er, you idiot, why are you trying to do something good? You are not the bully."

Qin Wei let out a long breath and said, "Oh, it's not that. It scared me to death."

Chen Jinyue rolled his eyes at him and said nothing.Qin Wei continued: "Old Chen, why don't you tell me what's going on?"

Chen Jinyue said: "Old Qin, you don't know. Didn't Xixi follow Tianyun to her aunt's house today? This brat ignored my Xixi. Can you tell me when has my Xixi been so neglected?"

Qin Wei waited curiously for Chen Jinyue to continue, but at this point Chen Jinyue had nothing to say. Qin Wei waited for a while and asked, "What next?"

Chen Jinyue said: "What happens next? It's gone."

Now it was Qin Wei's turn to get angry. He banged the table and shouted: "Crazy Chen, why did you come to my house with a gun just because of this? Do you think I am easy to bully because I am two years younger than you?"

When Chen Jinyue saw Qin Wei getting angry, he also felt that he was holding a gun to correct his mistake, so he stumbled and said: "Well, isn't that angry? Yes, he is angry."

He turned to look at Wang Ye and said angrily: "Let's not talk about this first, let's talk about this kid first."

Wang Yejian returned to himself and looked at the two of them innocently without saying a word.Chen Jinyue said: "Tell me, brat, why don't you talk to my Xixi, and why does she make you so annoying?"

Wang Ye took two steps forward to the coffee table and said, "Uncle Chen, Miss Luo Xi is beautiful and has a good personality. How can I hate her? It's just that we are not from the same world."

Chen Jinyue said: "What do you mean by not being from the same world? You didn't recognize what your uncle said before. Isn't it inappropriate to still say that now?"

Wang Ye looked at the two of them and said nothing.Qin Wei couldn't stand it any longer and said, "Xiaoye, just tell me if you have anything to say, I want to know too."

Wang Ye thought for a while and said: "Uncle, since Uncle Chen has said this today, I will share my thoughts. I grew up in a rural area, and then I came to the city and came into contact with people from poor parents. I have never been exposed to the above issues, and I don't want to be too tired."

"I just want to go to work hard, improve the food at home, and find a wife in the future. I can provide for my grandparents and grandpa until they grow old. I don't want to enter the official career, and I don't want to join the army. I just want to live a down-to-earth life."

Chen Jinyue said: "Have you ever thought that living a down-to-earth life has anything to do with ignoring my family?"

Wang Ye said: "Uncle Chen, you are a general and the problems between the children under you are just a joke. But I am different. Just the flies around Miss Luo Xi can annoy me to death. I can't cripple them all."
